title: HAP VideoInfo
use: Selected dimensions, fps, profile/level, maximum bitrate, packetization and RTCP parameters are distinct from advertised options.

title: HAP ReconfiguredVideoInfo
use: RECONFIGURE has width/height/fps/max_bit_rate/rtcp_interval; retains other negotiated transport fields.

title: HAP VideoStreamingOptions
use: Advertised codec options and resolution tuples do not expose a preferred-quality property.

title: HAP selected RTP parser
use: Pinned released parser forwards controller-selected TLV values to delegate, including bitrate. Current official latest parser crosschecked. Deprecated wiki is not the current API authority.

title: RTP synchronization and reports
use: RTP media clocks differ; SR relates RTP to a common time reference. Receiver reports loss/jitter/LSR/DLSR are observations, not Apple rendered timing.

title: H264 RTP constraints
use: RTP packetization does not alter encoded profile/geometry; exact profile compatibility and reference preservation matter.

title: Reduced-size RTCP
use: Do not assume reduced-size SR alone is negotiated; assess compound SR/SDES CNAME requirements against classic HAP behavior.

title: Opus RTP standard clock
use: Standard Opus RTP clock is48k independent of internal bandwidth; classic HAP implementation exception must be kept separate from modern Scrypted mode.

title: FFmpeg streamcopy
use: Streamcopy avoids decode/encode; scaling/rate conversion requires real decoded-frame processing.

title: FFmpeg codec rate control
use: Target bitrate, maximum rate and buffer size are different settings. Wire framing/loss recovery also consume bandwidth.

title: Scrypted exact sender
use: Classic sender associates last RTP with send wall clock; optional modern audio clock is separate.

title: Scrypted exact stream negotiation
use: Selected dimensions are upstream client hints; reconfigure sends bitrate feedback when provider supports it.

title: Scrypted exact FFmpeg path
use: Default path copies compatible video codec; debug transcoding uses selected rate/dimension hints.
